title: Take A Pass On This..
text: Take A Pass On This... If I wasn't in such a tricky situation,I would've sent this back immediately. I had to hand stitch 1/3 of a corner where they missed with their machine~their quality control obviously sucks. I also decided it was in my best interest to secure all the corners with french knots in an attempt to forestall what I can see will be disastrous shifting of the filling. I'm dreading ever washing this~I'll probably just use it as a drop cloth when it needs washing,then just throw it out. What a waste of my fixed-income money! Boo Hoo :(
